components.name: Spotify Connection Button
components.description: The only solid green action, reserved for connecting Spotify.

components.name: Paper Secondary Button
components.description: A bordered alternative for sample mode and secondary dialog choices.
components.css: .ds-btn-paper-secondary { min-height: 52px; padding: 0 1rem; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #857b69; border-radius: 0; color: var(--archive-ink, #181611); font: 600 .8rem/1.25 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-paper-secondary:hover { background: var(--archive-ink, #181611); border-color: var(--archive-ink, #181611); color: var(--archive-paper, #f3ebdc); } .ds-btn-paper-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-dark, #211e18); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Edition Row

components.name: Time Window
components.description: A square radio segment for the selected listening window.
components.css: .ds-time-window { min-width: 7rem; min-height: 46px; padding: .5rem .35rem; background: var(--archive-orange, #ef6b43); border: 1px solid var(--archive-control-line, #706757); border-radius: 0; color: #1b100b; font: 600 .66rem/1.2 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 160ms ease; } .ds-time-window:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-time-window:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-dark, #211e18); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Primary Export Action
components.description: The paper-filled leading action in the export colophon.
components.css: .ds-export-primary { min-height: 58px; padding: 0 .75rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .45rem; background: var(--archive-paper, #f3ebdc); border: 0; border-radius: 0; color: var(--archive-ink, #181611); font: 600 .74rem/1.25 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 160ms ease, transform 110ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-export-primary svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2.2; } .ds-export-primary:hover { filter: brightness(.94); } .ds-export-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-export-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-light, #fff7e8); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Archive Masthead Navigation
components.description: Flat private-view navigation with a short orange hover rule.
components.html: <nav class="ds-archive-nav" aria-label="Personal listening views"><button type="button">Year in Music</button><button type="button">Taste Dossier</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-archive-nav { display: flex; background: var(--background, #11100d); border-top: 1px solid var(--archive-line, #3c372e); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--archive-line, #3c372e); } .ds-archive-nav button { position: relative; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 1.35rem; background: transparent; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; color: #c9c1b2; font: 600 .76rem/1 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-archive-nav button::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 1.35rem; bottom: 0; left: 1.35rem; height: 2px; background: var(--archive-orange, #ef6b43); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 160ms ease; } .ds-archive-nav button:hover { background: #211e18; color: var(--archive-paper, #f3ebdc); } .ds-archive-nav button:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-archive-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-light, #fff7e8); outline-offset: -4px; }

components.name: Archive Period Select
components.description: A square dark select used for period comparison inside the dossier.
components.css: .ds-period-field { display: grid; gap: .45rem; color: #c7bfaf; font: 500 .66rem/1.4 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .055em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-period-field select { min-width: 13rem; min-height: 44px; padding: .65rem 2.2rem .65rem .75rem; background: #12110e; border: 1px solid var(--archive-control-line, #706757); border-radius: 0; color: var(--archive-paper, #f3ebdc); font: 600 .84rem/1.2 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-period-field select:hover { border-color: var(--archive-paper, #f3ebdc); } .ds-period-field select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-light, #fff7e8); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Soulseekr is a listening folio, not a dashboard: choose an edition and window, inspect the mounted artifact, then export it. The interface combines an independent record shop, a well-kept listening room, and an editorial design studio. It should feel warm, tactile, precise, private, and slightly obsessive.

The shell behaves like a catalog leaf around one dominant physical-media object. Dense tools live on an asymmetric paper control leaf while the selected artifact receives the dark, generous stage. Hairline rules, catalog numbering, compact metadata, and controlled asymmetry create identity without competing with album artwork or the seven artifact editions.
keyCharacteristics: Warm black workspace paired with bone-paper controls and one archive-orange accent.
Bodoni Moda display statements, DM Sans interface copy, and IBM Plex Mono metadata.
An asymmetric control leaf beside a mounted artifact stage, never a card-grid dashboard.
Record grooves localized to preview and audio contexts where they describe the product.
Restrained, task-led motion with a dedicated exception for the immersive Year in Music story.

rules.name: The One Archive Accent Rule
rules.body: Orange is rare and structural. Use it for selection, indexing, progress, and one small identifying gesture, never as an all-purpose fill.

rules.name: The Spotify Exception Rule
rules.body: Green belongs only to Spotify connection or an explicit Spotify state. Export, navigation, artifact selection, and generic success remain inside the archive palette.

rules.name: The Artwork Carries Color Rule
rules.body: Let album artwork and the artifact editions provide color variety. Keep the surrounding studio materially quiet.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Bodoni names the artifact, DM Sans operates the studio, and IBM Plex Mono verifies the archive. Do not exchange those roles casually.

rules.name: The Quiet Metadata Rule
rules.body: Metadata follows the heading it qualifies and stays visibly subordinate through size, weight, and spacing. It must never compete with the artifact name.

rules.name: The Artifact First Rule
rules.body: At every width, the current artifact is the single focal point. Controls, copy, and exports clarify it rather than form competing cards.

rules.name: The Mobile Discovery Rule
rules.body: On stacked layouts, every edition remains discoverable through horizontal scrolling, snap alignment, visible instruction, and keyboard arrow behavior.

rules.name: The Flat Workbench Rule
rules.body: Do not give stationary navigation, selectors, panels, or export rows floating shadows. Use a line or tonal step first.

rules.name: The Motion Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Motion may confirm a selection, introduce a temporary layer, indicate active playback, or support the dedicated story. Decorative loops and page-wide reveals do not belong in the studio.

rules.name: The Meaningful Circle Rule
rules.body: A circle must describe a record, avatar, center label, or playback object. It is not a general decoration.

rules.name: The Local Groove Rule
rules.body: Repeating radial grooves belong behind the mounted preview, inside the gateway record, and on audio surfaces. Never turn them into a page-wide wallpaper.

dos: **Do** make the selected artifact the brightest and most memorable object on the studio screen.
**Do** preserve the full workflow: choose one of seven editions, choose a listening window, inspect the mounted preview, then export it.
**Do** use Archive Orange sparingly for selection, indexing, progress, and catalog detail.
**Do** reserve Spotify Green for explicit connection actions and Spotify state.
**Do** keep Bodoni, DM Sans, and IBM Plex Mono in their established display, interface, and metadata roles.
**Do** keep controls at least 44px, expose visible focus, support logical keyboard order, and honor reduced motion.
**Do** label sample data, locked features, disabled time windows, loading, empty, and error states in plain language.
**Do** distinguish direct Spotify fields, local calculations, and creative interpretations in the dossier.
donts: **Don't** turn the studio into a dashboard, a bento grid, or a wall of equal cards.
**Don't** use Spotify Green for export, navigation, general success, decorative glow, or artifact styling.
**Don't** spread grooves, grids, blur, glow, large shadows, rounded pills, or orange fills across the whole interface.
**Don't** place explanatory metadata above or at the same weight as the heading it qualifies.
**Don't** homogenize the seven artifact editions into one generic card template.
**Don't** imply that Spotify affinity rankings are stream counts, total minutes, or any unsupported measurement.
**Don't** disguise sample data as connected data or substitute sample values into unavailable connected windows.
**Don't** add decorative perpetual motion. Keep the studio restrained and let Year in Music own the richer choreography.
